verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items is a fair question for a scriptable terminal, for example broadcasting input to many windows or acting on several tabs at once, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows per-window remote control from scripts: opening windows, sending text to any window, and changing titles. That is a scripting building block a user could loop over, not a documented multi-target or bulk capability. No broadcast or match-many feature appears in the pack.
